timing: Written before any PRISM source-coverage result, historical pixel value, predictability value, recovery summary or V7 model coefficient was opened.
reason: USA-NPN PRISM historical Spring Index has CONUS-only spatial extent, while some Nemes northern Motus receivers may lie in Canada. This limitation is known from source metadata, not from the V7 source-gate outcome.

predeclared_coverage_fallback.coverage: 0 to 90 N, -180 to 0 E/W longitude representation; 1 degree grid
predeclared_coverage_fallback.why_2013: The common BEST window ends before every Nemes focal migration year and before the PRISM/Nemes 2016-2019 outcomes.
predeclared_coverage_fallback.use_only_if: PRISM fails the frozen spatial-coverage gate because paired receiver coordinates fall outside the CONUS PRISM extent, while BEST passes the same >=50 individuals, >=10 route pairs, >=3 species gate.
predeclared_coverage_fallback.not_allowed_if: PRISM passes but gives an inconvenient or null focal result.

if_both_sources_feasible.interpretation: agreement strengthens robustness; disagreement is reported as source dependence and is not resolved by choosing the favorable source

stop_rule: If neither source passes its spatial/data-availability gate, close V7 without defining a third environmental predictor.
